thesis: The page is a paint lab's drawdown card: every section is a tint ticket printed with gallons, sheen, coverage and a sample range, and scrolling pulls the color bar across each card like a wet film test.

signature.name: Tint Ticket + Drawdown Bar
signature.summary: A tint ticket label caps each section with service data; a drawdown bar animates across as a colored rule whose width or opacity reflects coverage or rating.

motion.intro: Ticket prints line-by-line via staggered clip-path; drawdown bar wipes left-to-right across card bottom.
stories: Section backgrounds roll paper→warm→mid→paper like a paint strip
Ticket fields count up to values on entry
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left (scaleX 0→1, origin left, 200ms)
